methodology.headline: Our lines are built only from official numbers captured on the same day, and the pick is the highest-probability selection whose price is still inside −250…+10,000. Where an official input was missing the row is published without a line and the reason is on the flag list.

sections.From fixture to price: A fixture is read from a governing body, league, tour or track feed: NHL and Liiga schedules, the MLB Stats API, the EuroLeague games feed, the PlusLiga fixtures page and table, the Herreligaen table, the RLWC fixtures API. Strength inputs are the official for/against or sets won/lost columns of the same competition. We turn those into per-game attack and defence multipliers, apply a fixed, documented home edge, then price the match with a Poisson grid for goal sports or a normal margin distribution for points sports.
sections.Which selection we publish: Every originated selection is converted to a fair decimal price; only selections priced 1.40–101.00 (that is −250 to +10,000 American) are eligible, and of those the one we make most likely is the pick. That is why a row can show a 70% pick at a shade over even money rather than the 85% favourite: the brief asks for a high probability and a usable price, and those only overlap near the top of the band.
sections.Confidence labels: High needs our own probability at or above 70% on a table-based input with at least ten completed games behind it. A sport whose only strength input is a ranking list is capped at Medium; anything with fewer than ten completed games is capped at Low.
sections.What we do not do: We do not read a bookmaker price into our probability, we do not carry a number over from a previous snapshot, and we do not fill a blank. If a ranking, a table row or a start time is missing from the captured official pages, the field stays empty and the row is flagged.
sections.OLBG's role: OLBG is used for two things only: to confirm an event is on the card, and to record the price the listing displayed (data-decimal in the listing markup). It is never a source of fact about a team, a player, a score or an injury. Where a fixture's date comes from OLBG rather than the league, the row says so in its flags.

home_edge_basketball: league-wide home margin and spread of margins
home_edge_rugby_league: league-wide home advantage and margin spread
confidence_high: the brief's threshold, applied to our own probability

olbg_notes.summary: OLBG lists markets per sport behind numeric sport ids (Golf 5, Volleyball 21, Rugby Union 9, Cricket 7, Snooker 8, Darts 15, Baseball 12, Gaelic Football 25, Hurling 26, Greyhounds 28, Tennis 3, Motor Racing 14, Handball 20, Ice Hockey 13, Basketball 4, Rugby League 10). Each listing row carries the event link, the kick-off in a startDate attribute and OLBG's own price in data-decimal / data-american, which is what we record as the observed quote.

patterns./betting-tips/{Sport}/{sport_id}: sport hub; tip cards carry selection, market alias and OLBG price
patterns./betting-tips/{Sport}/All_{Sport}/All_Ev: full event list for the sport
patterns.a[itemprop=\"url\"][href*=\"event_id=\"]: event link; the h5 beside it is the event name as OLBG prints it
patterns.span.ui-odds[data-decimal][data-american: the displayed OLBG price for that selection

sport_notes.Ice Hockey: Every NHL fixture in the window, priced from the official league standings (goals for and against per game, last-ten form).
sport_notes.Basketball: EuroLeague and EuroCup fixtures priced from the official games feed; NBA fixtures are listed from the official CDN schedule but carry no line because no completed-game feed was captured.
sport_notes.Baseball: MLB postseason fixtures priced from the official Stats API standings and run environment.
sport_notes.Volleyball: PlusLiga fixtures priced from the official PlusLiga table (sets won and lost).
sport_notes.Handball: Herreligaen fixtures taken from the OLBG card and priced from the official Danish table.
sport_notes.Rugby League: Rugby League World Cup fixtures priced from the tournament's own completed results.
sport_notes.Tennis: Pairings come from the OLBG listing; strength comes from the official ATP singles ranking.
sport_notes.Motor Racing: The next Formula 1 round, priced from the official drivers' championship standings.
sport_notes.Snooker: Official WST fixtures for the window. No ranking feed could be read, so no line is published.
sport_notes.Golf: The captured PGA Tour leaderboard resolved to a completed event, so there is no field to price.
sport_notes.Cricket: OLBG-listed cricket markets for the window. The ICC ranking pages are script-rendered, so no line is published.
sport_notes.Darts: OLBG-listed darts markets for the window. The PDC ranking and fixture pages are script-rendered, so no line is published.
sport_notes.Rugby Union: OLBG-listed rugby union markets for the window. The URC table is script-rendered, so no line is published.
sport_notes.Gaelic Sports: GAA fixtures for the window. Club championship fixtures carry no official scoring table.
